core_meaning.short_meaning: Haifa (a coastal city); a pleasant, slender place
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Haifa corresponds to the Arabic form حيفا (Arabic حيفا (Ḥayfā) — the coastal city). Its core sense is haifa (a coastal city); a pleasant, slender place. Haifa is the Arabic name حيفا of the coastal city (Hebrew חֵיפָה). As a given name it recalls the city rather than a lexical root; the source gloss 'gardens' is unsupported and has been replaced. Some relate the place-name to حفا 'barefoot' or to the root ح ي ف 'to be slender', but neither is settled.
